text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for SERVICE: embeddings-queue-prod (high error rate) — alert_id=PD-84321 — auto-grouping=disabled

pagerduty: Auto-ack window started, escalation in 2m if unclaimed.

oncall-jamie: I'm taking this. pinging the bridge.

sre-lee: thx — can you paste top 3 error messages from the logs? I can start query if you want.

oncall-jamie: quick look shows 503s from embedder host pool, KV cache hits dropping. suspect kvcache eviction storm.

pm-anya: Customer impact? any customers seeing 5xx responses?

oncall-jamie: early signals: two customers on SLAs reported degraded embedding latencies, some retries. not full outage.

incident-bot: Duplicate suppression heuristics checked: 3 similar pages in 60s — suppression rule failed to merge due to differing alert keys (region tag mismatch). filing internal note.

sre-lee: hmm that's the suppression fallthrough we've seen in canary. I'll join bridge.

oncall-jamie: @cust-success-omar can you alert the two impacted accounts that we're investigating? say "intermittent embedding failures, working on mitigation"

cust-success-omar: on it, sending short PSA to the two dev contacts now.

sre-lee: quick mitigation: draining problematic pool instance and toggling prefix-caching off for 30s to stop evictions. rolling command now: ```./infra/drain-host --pool=emb-pool-eu --host=emb-07```

pm-anya: appreciate the quick note, please post ETA for customer follow-up.

oncall-jamie: drain started, re-routing traffic — watching metrics. will know within 2m.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledgement recorded by oncall-jamie (2891234572). escalation paused.

sre-lee: metrics: kv eviction rate dropping, 503s falling back to baseline. embedding latency stabilizing.

oncall-jamie: confirmed improvements, no new 5xx alerts for 5m. I'll hold the bridge for 10m then hand back to oncall rotation.

cust-success-omar: customers notified: "We've mitigated an intermittent embedding error impacting your requests. We're monitoring and will update if anything else."

pm-anya: action items: (1) update suppression rule to ignore region tag variance for this alert key, (2) postmortem to include kvcache eviction thresholds, (3) run a chaos test on kvcache to validate autoscaling. assigning to sre-lee for follow-up.

sre-lee: accepted. I'll open a follow-up ticket and schedule a short RCA sync.

oncall-jamie: handing off to rotation at 2891234589 — bridge closed for active mitigation.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page resolved (automated) — if new alerts appear, new thread will be created. :white_check_mark:
